Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: m365.message_trace.bytes
Metrics.Description: Total size of the messages ingested from the Exchange Online message trace, by delivery status.

Metrics.Name: m365.message_trace.messages
Metrics.Description: Messages ingested from the Exchange Online message trace, by delivery status. Per-message detail (sender, recipient, subject, message id) is on the m365.message_trace log twin, never here.
